verdict.rationale: Resend has a dedicated batch email endpoint (POST /emails/batch) supporting up to 100 personalized messages per request, explicitly documented in the API reference and llms.txt overview. Standard Resend send responses return per-email IDs, implying per-message status is included, though the pack doesn't show an explicit sample response payload for the batch endpoint. missing for 10: explicit sample response showing per-message status/error granularity, independent hands-on confirmation of batch behavior.
